comment: DIEGETIC sfx mapping. Content-word -> Openverse search query. Keys are matched against a shot's own catalog tags (his footage) or its stock category/alt-text words (Pexels stock) -- NEVER against cut timing. This is intentionally a flat, auditable table, not code: every content-word this engine will ever attach a sound to is listed here, once. An unmapped tag must yield NO sfx, never a guess -- see lib/sfx_match.py:resolve(). First key (in this file's order) that matches a shot's word set wins, so keep more specific words above more general ones if they could both fire on the same shot (e.g. 'ocean' before 'water').
